An SELinux boolean, set now and across reboots. Removing it leaves the value as it is.

```hcl
step "example" {
  selinux_boolean {
    name = "..."
    value = true
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Boolean, such as httpd_can_network_connect. |
| `value` | bool | Yes | Whether it is on. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_selinux_boolean.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the running value matches. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_selinux_boolean` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
